title: UKRAINE SYMVOL
description: This mod adds the flag and coat of arms of UKRAINE, the map of Ukraine, and  embroidery
body:
Ukraine Symvol Mod 🇺🇦

A Minecraft Forge mod that adds Ukrainian symbols and decorations to your world!

✨ Added content

🛡️ Coat of Arms of Ukraine
🇺🇦 Ukrainian Flag
🗺️ Ukraine Map
👕 Vyshyvanka outfit

All paintings work like vanilla Minecraft paintings and can be placed on walls.

💡 Why download this mod?
🇺🇦 Ukrainian atmosphere

Add patriotic Ukrainian style to your Minecraft world.

🏠 Decoration for buildings

Perfect for:

houses
cities
schools
roleplay servers
metro stations
military builds
⚡ Lightweight

Simple mod without complicated mechanics or lag.

🎮 Vanilla-friendly

Works naturally in Minecraft and is compatible with other mods.

⚙️ Features

✔ Forge 1.20.1 support
✔ Lightweight mod
✔ Simple installation
✔ Multiplayer compatible
✔ Ukrainian-themed decorations

📦 Installation
Install Minecraft Forge 1.20.1
Download the mod .jar file
Move it to:
.minecraft/mods
Launch Minecraft with Forge

🇺🇦 More Ukrainian content coming in future updates!
